criteria.description: The workbook opens and contains every required reporting sheet.
Program_Data preserves all eight source events in an Excel Table named ProgramEventsTable covering exactly A3:F11.
A genuine PivotCache binds exactly to ProgramEventsTable/Program_Data!A3:F11 with the six source fields in their exact identities and indexes.
The native PivotTable uses Region field index 1 as rows and Program field index 2 as columns.
Quarter field index 3 is a page filter with the selected item resolving exactly to 2024Q2.
Data fields are native SUM measures over Participants index 4 and Spend index 5.
The PivotCache is refreshable and configured to refresh when the workbook opens.
GETPIVOTDATA-linked KPI cells have Excel-calculated cached values 132 participants, $396,000 spend, and 50 North Outreach participants.
A clustered-column chart part contains a pivotSource relationship naming ProgramDeliveryPivot; a regular range chart does not qualify.
Critical integrity penalty for any fake/formula Pivot substitute, stale source, wrong field/filter/measure, absent refresh, wrong KPI, or non-Pivot chart.
